subject: Chief Product Officer, Digital Assets — Mark Smalley
opening: I am writing to apply for the Chief Product Officer, Digital Assets role at Euronext. My background combines 15 years of digital asset infrastructure with hands-on delivery of custody, tokenisation, and exchange systems at production scale.

proof_points.requirement: Experience at a crypto-native or digital asset exchange, custodian or tokenisation platform
proof_points.evidence: Co-founded CoKeeps — now Malaysia's largest Digital Asset Custodian by AUM. First blockchain company admitted to the Securities Commission Malaysia regulatory sandbox. Built production custody, wallet, and settlement architecture from the ground up.

proof_points.requirement: Working knowledge of token standards and DLT architecture
proof_points.evidence: Designed and built the SADO Protocol (decentralised order-book using PSBTs on Bitcoin). Deep experience with UTXO scripting, Schnorr/Taproot multi-signature schemes, token standards across EVM and Bitcoin ecosystems. Architected the Ordit SDK for ordinals/inscriptions (spun out as Ordzaar, raised US$500K, acquired).

proof_points.requirement: Product leadership and go-to-market strategy for institutional financial products
proof_points.evidence: 13 years operating as CTO-founder delivering institutional-grade blockchain infrastructure. Led product strategy from prototype through regulatory sandbox admission to production at CoKeeps. Founded Moonshot team at CakeDefi (1 to 10 engineers in 7 months), shipped DeFi staking products to 100K+ users.

proof_points.requirement: Stakeholder management across engineering, compliance, legal, and regulators
proof_points.evidence: Contributed directly to Malaysia's national Digital Asset regulatory roadmap alongside the central bank and Securities Commission. Coordinated engineering, legal, compliance, and regulatory stakeholders simultaneously at CoKeeps. 5-day advisory engagement with Baker Hostetler on digital asset custody frameworks.

proof_points.requirement: International and cross-border collaboration in diverse teams
proof_points.evidence: 15 years operating across 4 countries (UK, Malaysia, Singapore, US). Led distributed teams across time zones. Currently UK-based, experienced with European business culture and hybrid arrangements.

body:
My differentiator is that I built custody and exchange infrastructure from first principles rather than integrating third-party platforms. This gives me a depth of understanding about what tokenisation platforms abstract away, which translates directly into better product decisions when evaluating build vs buy, assessing vendor capabilities, and defining technical requirements for institutional-grade systems.

At Neuroware (my consultancy), I sustained 12 years of continuous operation on a $300K seed through disciplined capital allocation and a philosophy of shipping revenue-generating products before scaling teams. This lens on capital efficiency and product-market fit is directly applicable to building a new digital assets product line within an established exchange group.
closing: I am based in the UK, immediately available, and hold British citizenship (no sponsorship required). I am open to London, Paris, or Amsterdam hybrid arrangements. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience building institutional digital asset infrastructure from the ground up can contribute to Euronext's digital assets strategy.
